slides.title: Spark Day trouble
slides.text: It is Spark Day in Netville, and the sorting room should be full of festival post. Instead, the Magpie has locked the door with six trick locks and pocketed the keys.
slides.alt: Escape the Post Office begins: 0 of 6 locks open. Spark Day! The Magpie locked the sorting room with six trick locks and kept the real post inside.

focus.cue: Spark Day: the Magpie locked the real post inside

slides.title: Your stamps are the keys
slides.text: Pim lays your six Defender stamps on the door, one from every unit. The stamp proves you trained the skill. Each lock now tests it, one lock per unit.
slides.alt: Lock open! Lock 1, Sorting Gate, and Lock 2, Sealed Note, are open: their Roadwise and Keykeeper stamps did the work.

focus.cue: Locks open one by one, in stamp order

slides.title: Roads, codes and clues
slides.text: The first locks ask for your earliest skills. Route the golden letter, wheel the secret code, and pick the real message from footprint clues.
slides.alt: The Sorting Gate map: the golden letter waits at the Post Office. Roads lead past the Market and the Library to the Sorting Room.

focus.cue: Route the golden letter to the Sorting Room
More than one road leads there

slides.title: Six locks, six skills
slides.text: Pim reads the locks aloud before you begin. Say which unit trained you for each one.
steps: Sealed Note: secret codes, from Unit 2
Trick Inbox: spotting tricks, from Unit 4
Five Moves: the drill, from Unit 5
slides.alt: The Magpie's sealed note reads RSHQ, a scramble, with the Turn back and Turn forward buttons to try each shift.

focus.cue: The Sealed Note: a code from Unit 2
Turn the wheel until it reads as words

slides.title: No lock can fail you
slides.text: Here is the fair promise of the sorting room: there is no fail and no timer. A wrong try only wobbles a lock, and three hint feathers are yours to spend, counted honestly on your shield.
slides.alt: A wrong try: Pim shows the missed clue, a prize you never tried to win plus a rush. The moves wait below to try again.

focus.cue: A wrong try only wobbles the lock
Try again: the lock waits for you

slides.title: Your Defender words
slides.text: No new words today. These four carried the whole course.

words.means: a person who keeps people and messages safe
only for the people it is meant for, not for everyone
something fake that tries to fool you
the award a Defender earns for finishing the course

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Escape the Post Office and play the full escape. Open all six locks, earn your Defender shield, and set the town's real post free.
slides.alt: Lock open! Lock 1, Sorting Gate (Unit 1 stamp: Roadwise), and Lock 2, Sealed Note (Unit 2 stamp: Keykeeper), both open.

focus.cue: Open each lock in turn to earn your shield
